paper_metadata.title: Long-term outcomes of resective epilepsy surgery after invasive presurgical evaluation in children with tuberous sclerosis complex and bilateral multiple lesions

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the inclusion criteria and the clinical setting. However, as a retrospective single-center study using an electronic database, there is a risk of selection bias. The sample is limited to those who already underwent surgery, which may not represent the broader population of children with TSC and refractory epilepsy who were not deemed surgical candidates.

items.reasoning: The prognostic factors (imaging and neurophysiological modalities) are clearly defined.

items.reasoning: The study uses objective, computer-assisted methods (SPM, ECD algorithms) to interpret data, reducing subjective bias.
